definition: Simulates Algae Textile Mills operating for a day.
description:

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where algae bioreactors monitoring, mill logistics redundancy, or fiber extraction maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Algae Textile Mills Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Algae Textile Mills: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Algae Textile Mills — mills spinning algae into textiles.

Phase 1 — Prove (algae bioreactors): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (mill logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (fiber extraction): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (dye integration): mill hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and textiles-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
